name: Stratum Veil
description: Dark editorial scroll page with a rotated grid of drifting image columns behind a large title, followed by parallax text, sliding breakout words, an image strip and a back-to-top link.
contents: Rotated five-column image grid with large overlay title
Two large horizontally drifting breakout phrases
Strip of eight parallax image tiles
Loading dot overlay until images are preloaded
behavior: Columns, tiles, text and words drift with scroll position using eased transforms
Images are preloaded and a pulsing loader covers the page until ready or 6 seconds pass
Parallax is disabled when reduced motion is preferred
Back to top scrolls smoothly to the first section

props.name: bodyText
props.default: Psychedelics are illegal not because a loving government is concerned that you may jump out of a third story window. Psychedelics are illegal because they dissolve opinion structures and culturally laid down models of behaviour and information processing. They open you up to the possibility that everything you know is wrong.

props.default: the right to experiment with your own consciousness
